placements.title: Missing an explicit id is not a failure mode — the fallback chain guarantees a slug
placements.frame: When a memory arrives without an explicit id, does the pipeline's fallback chain (LLM id-gen, then deterministic slugify) reliably resolve to a slug and a successful commit?
placements.why: src-1 establishes the trigger condition future envelopes will keep recreating — a memory submitted with no explicit id field — and src-2 states the pipeline's standing, repeatable response to that condition: derive a slug via the LLM id-gen call or, failing that, the deterministic slugify fallback, then commit. This is not a one-time measurement or event but a design guarantee the pipeline is expected to satisfy on every no-id submission, which is exactly the kind of subject future test/envelope runs will keep feeding evidence into (pass, fail via LLM path, fall back to deterministic path, etc.) — the narrative grain test is met. No existing strata or narrative leaf was supplied to check against (both structures are empty for this repo), so nothing exact or close-enough exists to reuse or extend; this is a standalone NEW-tier mint with no forced parent.
